one_liner: Podio has a free-to-use REST API with OAuth2 (plus app-token flow) and an official vendor-hosted MCP server; ready to build.
auth_notes: OAuth2 server-side (authorization code) and client-side flows with self-registered client ID/secret. Username/password and app-auth flows also exist (app token exchanged for access token, still OAuth-style token endpoint). Access tokens last 8h, refresh tokens 28 days.
access_notes: Free and paid Podio accounts both have full API access; API key self-generated from account settings. Base limits 250/hr resource-intensive and 1000/hr others; higher limits via paid add-on.
blocker_notes: Rate limits are modest (1000 calls/hr) but not a blocker.

evidence.quote: The Podio API uses the [OAuth2 protocol](http://oauth.net/2/) for authentication.
You use the authorization code to obtain an access token
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts. Both have full access to the API
Provides complete programmatic access to all Podio functionality
The server is live at **[https://mcp.podio.com](https://mcp.podio.com)** — just point your AI platform at it and log in with your Podio account.
